llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam indicators: (1) Spoofing a legitimate platform (heavy reference to 'Lazada' with mismatched domain), (2) Unusually low prices and exaggerated discounts (Rp.5.000 -90%), (3) Fake or inflated statistics (9.999.999 Penilaian, 98.999.998 SLOT GACOR), (4) Combination of e-commerce and unregulated gambling/slot offerings, (5) No verifiable company information, (6) Use of psychological lures and urgency tactics ('Promo', 'Garansi', 'Chat 24 Jam'), and (7) Ambiguous privacy and customer service information. All of these traits are commonly seen in scam shopping/gambling platforms.
